review_text: This dress has no stretch and ran small. I normally wear and M or and 8 and it was way to tight on the back and bust

I rented this dress for vacation. It's so feminine, classy, and unique, absolutely loved wearing it. However, I am on the short side (short torso, wide ribcage, too), and am glad I sized up to the 2. A 0 would have been too tight across the chest, but the straps on the 2 were a bit long. Nothing unmanageable, just thought it was worth mentioning for any other shorties out there.
It is a little on the small end so if you are between sizes go up not down. But it is an A-line fit so it was just a tad tight in the chest. If that isn't an issue for you then no worries!
Loved the length, but it ran very small.  Way too clingy.

This dress definitely runs a little small around the midsection. The top lace cover was a little loose but otherwise it was perfect with spanx! I wore 3 inch heels and the back of the dress dragged a little (it has a mini train). Loved this dress!
I liked this dress a lot. I don't think it looked good on me though. My body is too straight to make it look flattering. It wasn't very forgiving if you were sitting down or ate too much.
Dress was amazing - just slightly tight across the bust/waist, but not too bad - I wore it anyway! Got a ton of compliments. Wore it with big gold earrings and strappy black heels.

The dress was super flattering and gorgeous. The material is heavy enough that it looks and feels expensive but it isn't too hot to wear to an east coast summer wedding. That said, it runs a little small. I am usually a medium / large and I got the large and had to REALLLLLLLY zip myself into it. Still great though and I got lots of compliments.

I have curves and I am mostly legs with a short torso at 5'6" and 160lbs. This dress made my belly and hips look large. Cute dress though! Very comfortable. It just wasn't made for me. Sadly I couldnt wear this to a summer bbq.

This dress was overall AWESOME.  I ordered a 14R and a 16R as 12/14 is what I usually wear, but I am always worried about zip-up dresses with no stretch because I have a wide ribcage. In my opinion, the dress runs a little small in the fitted bust area as the 16R was tight around my ribcage. Besides that tightness, the dress was perfect. I am 5'6 and it hit just at the floor and I wore flats. If you want to wear heels, order a tall/long! It was comfortable with dancing and the skirt was super fun doing spins! Overall, I would definitely rent this dress again!

Great fit, beautiful dress, runs a little bit small so order 1 size up.  Perfect for a wedding!  I got a ton of compliments and was comfortable all night.  I was a little nervous the deep neckline even with sheer would be too revealing but it was great - perfect cut and built in cups worked well.  No bra needed.  I highly recommend this dress - I would rent it again!

I'm normally a 10/12 in street clothes, but wore the 14 and would have sized up if I'd had it.  It was tight in the midsection/ hip area, so I wore shapewear for a smoother line.  Length was great for my 5'-4" frame.  I couldn't even get the 12 on, so glad I had the 14 as a backup size.  Super comfortable, but the lace neckline needed a bit of  fashion tape to not fold down.

I decided to rent this dress for a wedding because I just didn't love anything in my closet. I am so happy with my decision! The dress was perfect -- dressy enough for an evening wedding but not overly formal. And because I have an "apple" figure, I always look for structured dresses to give me a good silhouette. This dress didn't disappoint! It has no stretch, so I definitely had to go a size up (needed room for dinner and dancing!) but it worked really well. The pockets are awesome, the color was gorgeous, and I felt really beautiful. I would absolutely recommend!
This dress was very cool, but much too small for me. It's fitted, so if you have a little extra around the middle, order up.
should be described as form fitting

Dress runs a bit small and has no stretch, so ladies, size up. I'm 5'7" and with 3.5" in heels the Long was perfect length. The color, the lilac flower pattern and the cut of the dress it to die for. Got compliments on the dress all night.
It runs slightly smaller, I'm glad I got a size larger. Otherwise it was extremely comfortable and flattering.

I am 5'4" and I don't like to wear high heels so I rented the petite size based on other reviews.  It ended up being about an inch too short - even for my shorter 2 inch heels.  I wish I would have rented the regular length.  Also, it is very tight in the bust.  I already sized up to  6 over my regular 4 but it was a close call.  Zipper is finicky (which seems to be the case for every dress.)
Fit well, but on the smaller side. Length was great and fit "the girls" just right.

This is a very pretty dress, BUT ... if I had read the reviews more closely, I wouldn't have rented it.  I  barely fit into the L (there is no XL) and I normally wear a 10.  It was super-tight around the rib cage.  Good news was I couldn't eat much.  :-)  Also, although the fabric is wonderfully soft and almost pajama-like in comfort, it's super wrinkly.  I was afraid to press it because the fabric seemed so delicate, so I just wore it as is, believing that the pattern would (mostly) hide the wrinkles.

I'm a size 14 reg and this was super tight, and not wearable for a real size 14. a 10 or 12 would order the 14 and it would fit. It's also a bit on the short side. The color was pretty and vibrant and if it had fit I would have gladly worn it.

Pros: beautiful color, substantial fabric.
Cons: it really does fit like a sausage casing.  Twenty years ago I would had rocked it :).  
Also runs small (in addition to the very slim fit.)
Too short for me to wear.  I am not very tall (5' 2" and this was too short for comfort in public).  The length surprised me as the dress otherwise looks "sweet".

I loved this dress! I had so many compliments on it. It has ribbing built into the top part of it. It is really tight in the chest area. I posted one of the pics so you can see it pushed all upward and was a little over flowing out the top. I had to squeeze them in with no bra and had more cleavage than I would have wanted. Order one size up from your regular dress size and the next size for back up. The detail on the dress was amazing. Overall it was perfect and I felt beautiful!

The dress was a little tight, but fitted at size 4. There is a lot of netting so it got caught on my bracelet and other random stuff. Also the fabric underneath would ride up a little. Overall though, I loved how I felt and looked in the dress and everyone loved it.

I loved this dress! It was a last minute choice and I wasn't convinced I loved it until I had it in front of me. The beading and sequins are so luxurious but this dress is so comfortable. I wore it out dancing with friends and got so many compliments! I will definitely be renting this again! It also comes in white!

I wore this for my bridal shower and got a ton of compliments! It fit GREAT!  I ordered the 8 and 10 and could have gone with the 8 but I wanted to be comfortable when opening gifts.  I would totally recommend this to anyone!
It runs a little large however that is the look of the dress. I paired it with brown boots and it looked amazing. I want to keep this dress and will be renting again. My favorite DVF dress so far.

I rented this for an annual gala event that has a theme. This year was a vintage-themed party around KC's heyday of the Jazz era. I am NOT a basic black dress person but rented it because I thought it looked like it would evoke a vintage glam look while flattering my figure (which a flapper cut would not). My size has been changing frequently; I have a 14-month old and am nursing, so I wasn't sure what to order. I wear a 12P jeans but recently bought a 10P dress from Ann Taylor, and tried on 8 regular formal dresses that fit but didn't flatter. The 10P was too big but the 8P was perfect. I wanted to be comfortable and dance so the 8P hit just shy of my shoe toes. If I wanted it to fit "right" I would have been fine in the regular. But I wanted it slightly short so I wouldn't step on it.

I ordered this dress for a fraternity philanthropy event at my school that is a football game in our stadium between two fraternities. At halftime, they have like a homecoming presentation, and I was my sorority's representative. GREAT dress for the bright lights in the stadium! It sparkled and was wonderful. Although I ordered the 6R, my second choice was the 4R (which ended up being the one I wore), and it fit like a glove! So it does run large. I wore flats with it because I figured the turf would not be smart for heels, and it hit the floor perfectly. The color appears like a gold color online but definitely was more of a rosy/blush shade, which still looked absolutely phenomenal! I got compliments, people gave my friends compliments about it, people overheard it being complimented by those who didn't even know me! I would suggest this dress to anyone, and I wish I could have kept it! I didn't wear any jewelry and wore a soft pink gloss with sparkly eye shadow. I wore my hair all pinned back. This was my favorite floor length dress that I have ever worn in my life, and words seriously do not do it justice with how amazing it ended up fitting and looking! So comfortable! And what a small world, my friend Martha, who posted below me, and I got the same dress and didn't even know it until pictures went up! Great minds think alike ha! Wonderful overall experience with Rent The Runway and I will do business with them a lot more!

The dress while not tight was a little restricting when trying to twerk on the dance floor but I was able to move and dance fairly freely.  The dress was not a hot as I expected it to be and I was able to have fun without ending up pouring sweat. The dress looked beautiful and at 5'3" with 4" heels the dress barely touched the floor. The dress looked very expensive and was a great deal.  I would recommend the dress especially if you want to cover a few bumps in the tummy area,  with the print and good fabric I didn't even need spanx.
This dress is gorgeous and feels luxurious to wear. For me, it ran a bit big in the hips and bottom area, and it was longer than I expected, but it worked great for a special night out.

I absolutely loved this dress!! I got so many compliments at my office Holiday Party! The night before I was supposed to receive the dresses I actually got an email saying that the dress in my size (22W) was unfortunately returned damaged by another customer, luckily they still sent my backup size (20W) which ended up fitting perfectly!! The only downside to this dress was that if I wasn't careful some of the sequins would catch on each other, but it wasn't a real issue - only happened when I first tried it on. If you have sensitive skin the sequins might be a little irritating because this dress is no joke entirely covered in sequins. It wasn't too bad for me and I have super sensitive pale skin, but I only wore it for maybe 6 hours. Overall I would definitely recommend this one!
This dress does fall a little low and I was worried my bra would show so I added some bobby pins. Wondering if I maybe should have gotten a smaller size or a different bra. Definitely a low cut.

This dress was really pretty and flattering.  I wish I would have taken a photo.  I wore nude heels with this dress and it looked amazing.  However the heels were a must because they were 5 inches, and I'm already 5'7, but the dress is so long I needed the extra height to look ok.  Other than that the dress was GREAT!

The dress fit like a dream!  Glad I listened to the reviews and got my back-up size as one size down.  I am thicker though the waist and had so problems with fit.  Bigger hips would have rocked this dress as well.  The chest area fit just fine, no tape needed (36C).  I elect to wear a strapless bra but a traditional bra would have worked just fine.  I did wear an undergarment to help smooth things out a little bit but could have gone without it as well.  In May, in Georgia, and outside, I stayed cool while others were overheating.  Highly recommend!

I loved this dress, but I should have listened to other reviewers: it runs BIG! I sized down to a 12 but could have gone 2 sizes down. The fabric has a lot of give and is thick enough to be forgiving so don't worry about going smaller! You can see in the pictures that the top and waist had lots of room even one size down. However, this dress was comfy and fun. I got a ton of compliments!
the top was too big for me so it showed my bra. However, it was a cute and comfortable dress and it has pockets.
the fabric was very dense and heavy.  I would wear this in the winter with tights and flat boots.
This dress was easy to wear and the fabric was beautiful.  It his at the right part of the waist and I'm very pleased with the rental.

I rented this dress with Unlimited to wear to work with a cardigan and then on the weekend for a fancy brunch. It didn't work that well with a white cardigan, since the dress is drop waisted, but I made it work. For my weekend brunch, it was quite the hit with flat leather sandals. The dress is lined but I still stayed cool in the heat. 

The dress does run big - I recommend sizing down 1 size for a more fitted look. It was generous in the bust area (where I have most sizing issues). It's a great dress for short ladies too!

I wore this dress to a Scotch and Cigars party that I hosted.  I received compliments all night and felt so gorgeous.  This was my first RTR experience and it was absolutely perfect!  I am 5'2 and with 5" heels the 2R was too long, so I am so glad I also rented the 2P, which was the perfect length.  I usually wear a 4 or a 6 and the 2 was snug but very comfortably.  A+++!

I thought this dress was great and I got a ton of compliments. It's a fun way to add some glitz to an event. I would say the dress runs a tad large. I'm broad shouldered and busty and the dress was even a smidge loose on top. I would suggest ordering a size down if you think there is a chance it may be too big. Even though it's sequins, there is definitely some give in the dress, so you could definitely squeeze in and with the ruching, I don't think anyone could even tell.

I rented this dress for my engagement photos and it was perfect.  It was very slimming and hugged me in all the right places.  It shows off your curves but the material has a way of holding everything it so its almost like Spanx but extremely comfortable.
The dress was a little bulky for my taste--it has a shape of its own, and that shape was too big/not super flattering on me.

Absolutely adore both this designer and this dress. It's beautifully cut and eye catching, and honestly, this dress is man catnip. The color and the hem ... I walked through Penn Station NYC and felt eyes on me ...
After receiving a dress with a stain on it, they sent me this dress next day and it worked great. It's really comfortable. The customer service experience was above and beyond my expectations!

not for petite people.  The waist was super high and the crotch super low.  I'm usually a medium but it ended up swallowing me. Needless to say, I had to return. Also, it's a very soft material, almost like corduroy.

Loved the dress, thick lined material makes it very flattering. The only drawback is that it stretches out a bit, so by the end of the night it became a bit loose on me. Next time I will  sized down. Otherwise, compliments all night :)

Pros - Material flows nicely 
Cons - Huge and not true to size.

Yuck! This dress totally hid my chest, making me look even flatter than I am. The abdomen region was stretched out or just too much fabric - looked like i was trying to hide a baby bump with nothing to fill it! It was a bit tight through my thighs, but that happens sometimes. The long was at least 1 inch too short with no shoes on.
This dress fits amazingly (does run small), and is great for a dress-up occassion, or everyday event. I ended up wearing it to church, but could dress it up or down. Would definitely rent/wear again.
I thought the dress was pretty but I didn't like the mesh/net type material on which the embroidery was done. It ran a little small in the chest and waist. I didn't end up wearing it.

This dress is longer than it appears in the pictures so it was able to be worn to work with a blazer.  The lining comes all the way down to the bottom of the dress which I really like.  The top is definitely tighter than the bottom of the dress.  It made the dress very comfortable to move in while wearing heals and walking around at work.  I normally wear a 4 and sized up to the 6 and it was the perfect fit.
Pretty and nice for a hot day.

I wore this to the Khaki ball and it was perfect! I got compliments all night on the back of the dress. I went with the 12R because the 10r was a little snug on my girls:) I wear a 36 DD. Length was great, barely skimmed the floor and i was wearing 3 1/2 - 4 inch heels. Would definitely rent again!

Dress was a little too risqué for work- tight, short, and had a big cut out on the back that was more extreme than I thought, so I did not end up using the rental.  It would have been perfect for an event, but not for work!
I originally ordered the size 2, it fit but was a little tight. I'm Glad i went with the size 4- It fit perfect and was very comfortable!!
its a very short sweater, hits right at the top of the hip.  i wore high waist pants and it felt ok.  would have liked it a tad larger but it still looked very nice. great color, great detail.

I usually wear a 4 but it was a little small so I went with the 6.  It fit like a glove and the low neckline is really flattering.  The major issue is the cutouts in the back.  When I looked in the mirror from behind I could see all the way up my thigh to the bottom of my butt.  It made me self conscious when I was walking down the street and if you have any bit of cellulite it's on display.
Not as structured as I expected, but the back is so sexy! Super comfortable.

I rented this for a friend's birthday party in size 2. My usual size is 0, but Elizabeth & James tends to run a bit small. The dress fit very well, and was comfortable. But without a slit in the back and with the tight fit, walking was somewhat constrained. The fit was quite slimming. With a cardigan, the openings in the back would not be visible, and this could be even worn to work.
The dress fit perfectly and I completely recommend it. It was perfect length, not too long, not too short, and extremely comfortable.

I liked the dress overall and would wear it again.  For the cons - It was small (wore a 12 instead of a 10) and the material was different than expected.  It was hard to get out of all the wrinkles b/c it was a thick material.

Gorgeous dress! Definitely runs small, I'm generally a 2-4 but in this dress I was definitely a 4-6! I wore the size 4 because my little sister told me it fit perfectly (it felt very tight, as it has no stretch whatsoever), and because the size 6 was missing the hook and eye closure that keeps the very deep V closed. Altogether, I was happy with my order and I would wear this dress again (though next time, I would wear it with spanx)! It's lightweight, bright, and perfect for a summer event.

This dress was so flattering and I felt completely comfortable all day and night. I opted for the 12 over the 10 since the waistband doesn't have any give. I should have worn a backless bra since the opening in the back doesn't cover a regular bra, but instead had my husband pin the back closed to cover it. It was much better looking when left open. Live and learn. I would rent this again if I didn't love so many other dresses on here.

I unfortunately had to return this dress because size 0 was too small and size 2 was too large. It didn't fit me right but I do have to say that it's a very cute outfit and it will stand out in any parties.
Rented the 8 - fit perfect but I'm 5'9" & this was waaay too short for Work & honestly I wouldn't wear this out, I'd feel very uncomfortable as it's so short!  Bummed cause it's a super cute dress!

Gorgeous dress but too small. I have broad shoulders and spend a lot of time in the gym so I usually have to size up - especially when ordering couture. I was only able to order the 8 on this occasion and it is too late to exchange but will definitely try it for my next formal affair.  I loved this dress and wanted to wear it to an aristocrat wedding in Europe but I could barely get the zipper over my bottom.

This dress was gorgeous.  I normally wear a size 4-6 and based on other reviewers I knew this dress ran small so I ordered a 6 and 8.  The size 6 fit but was a tad tight so I ended up wearing the 8.  The material is very thick and stretchy, so even though it was tight it was still comfortable.  I danced all night with no issues.  I got lots of compliments and my husband loved it.  The color is beautiful and it really accentuates your arms and booty.  I would definitely rent it again.

I am a true size 6 and I ordered this dress in a UK 10 (UK conversion of US 6) I had to send it back and order a UK 12 (UK conversion to US 8) and the larger size fits well if not still snug in the hips.  Otherwise, I love this dress.  It is form fitting and gorgeous.  I plan to wear to a birthday dinner with black leather jacket and booties.

I loved almost everything about this rental for my non-profit's annual fundraiser gala. I usually wear a 4 and I wore the 6 petite because the 4 was just a little too tight on me. But as for the quality of the dress, it was red carpet glamorous and so elegant. I felt like a princess and I had people complimenting me ALL night. Even though I am short, my 3 inch heels allowed it to sweep off the ground so I floated around the room. I wore a strapless bra with it and everything stayed secure all evening so I felt comfortable moving around the event. The only negative I have to say is that I needed my gal pal with me every time I had to use the bathroom because unzipping/zipping the dress was a real process. But I highly recommend this rental, you won't be disappointed. And it was TOTALLY worth the price. I just wish I could wear it forever.

The waistband does not have any elasticity, and was tight on my ribs, so I needed help to get the zipper done up but once it was zipped it was like a glove! I wouldn't have wanted to size up though since the fabric on the shoulders and arms was almost slightly loose.
Really beautiful dress, a little tight in the bust area, but overall great fit and very sexy red color.

This is my favorite rental to date. The jumpsuit is so comfortable, made with a thick stretchy fabric. I have  a long torso and a short inseam and this fit perfectly. Even though you have to take the whole thing off to use the bathroom, it's so stretchy that it was not as problematic as I anticipated. I received many many compliments. I felt on trend and comfortable. The neckline was fabulous, showing a bit of cleavage and accentuating my clavicle. My only complaint was that there was a stain on the right knee but I don't think anyone noticed. I would love to have kept this outfit!!

Perfect dress for an art show date. Definitely runs large. I am almost always a size 8 and the 6 wasn't even snug. I had to wear a strapless bra with it because of the mesh top, but other than that it was comfortable and flattering.

This dress really is a magnificent dress. It was very comfortable all night, and I never had to worry about it being too short (I'm 5'9" and was wearing 3in heels). The pockets held my phone, id and cash, and a rollerball perfume and you couldn't even tell they were full. I could have easily fit more in them too but I didn't have anything else I needed. No problem with the under arm scratching as other people suggested. Really just a flattering dress that catches the eye. I paired mine with shoes very similar to the picture and an updo.

this was a very flattering dress. the material on the bodice is quite thick, so it definitely helped hide imperfections. i found it could be worn either on or off the shoulder quite easily which made it possible to wear a regular bra.
It was a super nice had it been new. The shirt was a little old and grungy. So I didn't wear it
Though it was very pretty, it is a thicker material. I found it a bit itchy and it ran a little large. I think it would work well on someone who is taller.
It definitely runs large, happy I got the size down after reading the reviews. I received so many compliments on the color and style and it was perfect for dancing.... not restricting at all!

Not too short (with opaque tights) on someone 5'4" (in two-inch heels). It took me a little while to figure out how to tie the sleeves, but they're very cool. I usually wear a 2 or 4 in dresses, and the 2 was the right size in this one. Nice and warm, too -- a thick, lovely kind of crepe.

Unfortunately this dress had a few issues.  It looks beautiful on the model and many of the other girls that ordered it, but I am a true 0 and this was too big everywhere.  I had excess fabric under my armpits (think dolman style top) and it was too large in the waist and hips.  I also struggled with the zipper where it hit the embellishment at the waist as many other renters have noted and the zipper did not lie flat, there were a few bulging areas so I wasn't able to wear it.  I think that the dress would have been very flattering if it fit properly, but I definitely think the XS would fit a size 2 better than a 0.

I loved this dress, it fit well (ran a bit big, I used the smaller of the 2 sizes I ordered) and I received so many compliments.  Even people I hadn't talked to in years commented on social media about how much they loved this dress.  It wasn't too revealing, but I felt sexy without it looking like I was "trying too hard."

I wore this to a conservative work party and got a ton of compliments. It was comfortable, perfect for a winter affair, but my complaint was that the lining kept poking out at the bottom. Also, it fit perfectly on me and even though I did wear Spanx with it, they weren't necessary. However, the sleeve with the lace on it was really constricting whenever I bent my arm at the elbow. Not a big deal, but started to get irritating after a few hours. But overall, perfect for the night.  I also rented the necklace that I LOVED.

So this was a a really really fun rental.  I'm taller and thinner, so it was a really fun piece to pull off.  I feel like it ran kind of large - usually between a 4 and a 6 I am in between there, but the 4 seemed kind of big on me, so I would go with the smaller of what you normally wear if you have to choose.  The sequins are a little scratchy, but if you're looking to stand out at a holiday event this is the piece for you!

Pros - love all the lines
Cons - runs large
Dress is gorgeous and my only complaint is that it's very long.  I'm 5'6 and ordered the SR and wore 3 inch heels and dress was still slightly dragging the ground.
The dress was really comfortable, and fit like a glove. A bit heavy, but that's the price you pay for all the sparkle! Runs a little large.

The dress definitely runs small. I am normally a four and ordered a two as a backup. I didn't even try on the four as the two fit perfectly when I tried it on. (What a dream!) I was a little surprised at the length of the dress. I am 5' 8" and it almost came to my knees, which I didn't expect based on the picture of the model. However, I thought the length was perfect since I was at a wedding and wanted to be somewhat conservative. The wedding was outdoors on the ski slope (reception inside!), so  I wore the dress with tights and heeled booties. The neckline was a perfect blend of conservative but with a sexy twist, and I  thought it was a great choice for a wedding  - neither flashy nor boring. I got several compliments, even from the bride herself! The quality of the dress is great (as is the case with all Halston dresses). It was a thick material that does not cling in weird places.  I highly recommend this dress! Unfortunately, I don't have a full length picture yet (although the photographer did take one of a friend and me...once I get that picture, I will post!)

This was my first RTR experience, and wore this to a black tie wedding.  I was a little nervous, as my package didn't arrive until almost 7:00 on delivery day, but that was the only issue, and not RTR's fault.   The 6L was too big, but the 4L fit almost perfectly.  It tugged slightly to the side with the one-shoulder style, but I was the only one who noticed.  There is no stretch to the fabric, but the fit is very flattering.  Definitely more navy than it appears in pictures, it was nice to not wear the typical black.  I wore 3" nude heels, and the length was perfect.  I received compliments all night long- I was sad to return it.  I would absolutely rent this dress again, and will be using RTR in the future!
Great shirt that can be dressed up or down.  It feels more like a dress when you have it on.   Loved the lightweight material and fabric.
this blazer looked so cute in the picture.  in real life it ran much larger and didn't hang as cleanly.  The fabric was super soft, I wish it had fit better or I would have totally kept it!
I ordered the 6 and 8 as a backup, felt the 6 ran a little large and could have gone with a 4.  Recommend get a smaller size as a backup.
I got many compliments throughout the night. The only issue is the dress is more orange than red.

It fit so oddly in the chest area! I was literally freaking out when I was getting ready for the wedding because the chest area was waaay too big and the sticking made it look like I had an extra folds. I fit a size 2 perfectly, all the time usually, but it wasn't the case for this. My girls came to the rescue and we were trying to figure out a ton of solutions and tried many until one worked -- wearing two bras -- which kind of helped smooth the areas over, but the folds were still pretty visible. Also, it is a little tight on the arms irritating my skin.

This dress does run large. I am normally a size 12 no question. I am glad I got the backup in a size 10 but truthfully could have used a size 8. I have a fairly large chest and the top was huge. I used some clothing tape to keep it from gapping. Otherwise, the dress was super comfy and let me dance the night away. Would recommend this dress just size down!!! This was also my first time using rent the runway and I really enjoyed it.

Great bright color for the summer! I would never buy this dress and put it in my closet, but was so happy to rent! I ordered 4 and 6 size, 4 was a bit big on me. I guess 2 would be perfect. I ended up wearing bra underneath to keep it tighter. The fabric is a little bit heavy if the weather is hot, but we got a perfect day, it wasn't too hot
LOVED this out fit - really didn't think I would but went out on a limb. Very flattering but runs VERY big. I normally wear a 4 and went with a 0. Definitely go down a size or even two.

This was my back up dress so I didn't end up wearing it, but I will rent this again.  I normally wear a 2, and the 0 long ended up fitting, because the 2L was a little big.  There is quite a big of give in the fabric and it hugs your curves in all the right places.  Great dress!!
Very tight in the bust!

First of all, this looks like it's tweed in the photos. It is not. It's a stretchy material with a tweed pattern printed onto it. Very strange. It's lined, so it's still pretty heavy though. It runs a little small in the hips, so if you have bigger hips, size up. I probably would have worn it if it weren't so tight in the butt. It's a cute cut.

I ordered the size 22 because I personally tried it on in the Flat Iron store because that was all they had.  I think I could of gotten the size 20 but I didn't want to risk it due to the fact that I have a heavy bust.

I normally wear a size 18.
Very comfortable especially if you have a bigger bust

This dress was stunning but very tight around the rib cage and bust. The 4 wouldn't zip over my ribs, but fit everywhere else nicely. I ended up haveing to go with the 6 so it would zip over my ribs and it was a bit big everywhere else. That said, it looked great, photographed wonderfully and I got tons of complements

I really, really wanted to wear this dress, but it was too tight in the torso. I have larger than average breasts (D+ cup) so I should have known based on the other reviews (where someone said anyone above a C would have an issue, but I really wanted to wear it. They didn't have a larger size for me, so I'm lucky my backup dress worked.
Runs small so I wore a size up. Lots of compliments. Very flattering fit. The only downside was the bow in back kept coming unclasped.
The size runs small in the chest but it's a beautiful dress.  The lace/fabric is tick

This is a gorgeous dress! It really shows off your shoulders and your curves, but doesn't leave any room for error. It definitely runs small!!! I rented my regular size, plus one size up. But it was so snug, I had to get an additional size up overnighted to me. I praise customer service for helping me get it here on time. And it was very flattering and elegant to wear. But I highly recommend sizing up with this dress. I normally wear a 2R, but the 6R fit perfectly. Great length, beautiful through the shoulders, waist and hips. I absolutely loved it!

I should have followed the advice in the reviews and ordered a size 6. Fit great, except couldn't get the zipper up the top of the back. Very tight waist. However, it was gorgeous and will order it again in a size 6 for an upcoming event!
Loved the color and style of this dress. Perfect for a evening wedding. It was a little tight in arms and in bust area.

This dress was super cute and I got plenty of compliments on it. As a shorter girl, I was afraid the dress would be super long, but it hit me about mid calf, which with heels looked good. As an off the shoulder dress, I was afraid i would have to pull it up every 10 minutes for the whole day, but it was actually pretty secure and I only found myself pulling up the dress when I was dancing. The only issue was there was metal wiring in the torso that stuck through the material inside and continuously stabbed me throughout the night. It was more uncomfortable than painful. Overall, it was really great dress.

Loved the color of this dress. The fit was a little tight around my bust but was able to make it work. I accessorized with a large gold bracelet and ring which was perfect. Another win for Rent the Runway!

I was hesitant to order a dress online and not have a back up but I read the reviews and the top is rather fitted as other people comments. I am 29 weeks pregnant and I felt amazing in the dress. I wish the petite was in stock as it was difficult to go up stairs etc due to the length other than that an awesome dress!

I rented this dress for a wedding that I was attending as a guest, but also coordinating.  I wanted to be comfortable and pretty while working my tail off, but also look great standing next to my husband (the best man).  The dress is really beautiful in person, so much prettier than the pictures and it killed me that it didn't fit.  I could zip it, but I had horrible smashed boobs and couldn't breathe.  I normally wear a 16W in dresses, but this fit more like a regular 16.  I tried to get the 18, but it wasn't available.  RTR was great about getting me 2 different dresses to me before my event, I wore the Hello Dolly and looked great.  I will rent this dress again, in the 18.
Fit is a bit on the small side.  The dress is not very forgiving in some areas.  I loved the neck line.

This dress was beautiful and very well made.  Fabric was delicate but sturdy, and didn't feel cheap like some lace dresses.  Though like others have said, this runs pretty small.  I have a larger chest and while the size 10 fit, I needed a friend to help tip in the back because of the awkwardness of the zipper and tightness in the chest area.  It is also rather short, and that's saying something for my 5'2" frame, but I felt comfortable in it the whole night anyway.  I normally wear an 8 so I am glad that I sized up in this.  Got lots of compliments on it though I probably wouldn't rent again.

Wore this gorgeous dress for a #blacktie #wedding. I love how simple and chic this dress was while still being a stunner. It runs small (I usually wear a 6 but wore the 12, mostly due to the lack of room in the chest). I could have worn the 10 but I played it safe. It also has pockets, looks great with heels or flats, and can be dressed up even more with big jewelry. I would totally rent this dress again!
It definitely ran small, it was snug in the chest. Glad I went up to a size 12. Will definitely rent again!

When other reviews say the dress is tight around the middle.  They mean it.  It is very tight on the lower rib area.  I am usually between an 8 and 10 I could not zip the 10.   If you have a large upper body size up on this one  for sure.

I got a lot of compliments on this dress; however, if you have a full bust, BEWARE. You will definitely be showing off your figure in this dress (which could be good or bad depending on your style and comfort level). I typically do not show much cleavage and wished that I'd ordered a size up for a little more coverage on the top. The dress was perfect for the rest of my body and the length was great.  I wore three inch heels and the dress came just above the ground to where it didn't drag. The material was amazing and the perfect thickness where it wasn't too hot. If you're comfortable showing off your curves, this is a great option!

Pros: Great color! The lace detail is stunning.
Con: I'm a 36DDD, this top did not even come close to zipping. Not a dress for girls with big boobs!

Yes this dress runs small; I tried S and M and the S was feeling too much like a sardine can.  The medium was comfortable and still mostly flattering, though the dress bunched up a little in the front of the armpits.  The design on the front and back is gorgeous.  It looked navy to me in the pictures on the listing but was black in person.  The material is thick and good for cold weather.

I found this dress to run a tad small in a size 6.  I'm 5'5"; 130lbs; 32G.  I was pouring out of the top a little in the 6 without a bra, although the size 8 was too big on me all over even with a bra.  After trying them on one after another and switching a few times, I ended up in the 6 for the evening.  I'm not sure why there was such a huge difference between the two consecutive sizes.  I liked how there was boning and a corset within the dress - and the thickness of the fabric.  Unfortunately, both sizes came quite wrinkled so I had to iron it (especially the hem) from the inside, but the fabric ironed nicely on low heat.  The high-low hem length was perfect for a formal event, without having to worry about a gown being too long on my short frame! I paired the dress with navy satin heels, a gold purse, gold jewelry and red lipstick!  Certainly a bright, happy color for spring - loved it.

This is hands-down the most fun top I have ever worn! I'm usually not one to wear crop tops, but this one left just a tiny bit of my belly showing so I didn't feel self-conscious. It was definitely tight though. I plan on renting this in a size XL next time for comfort, but keep in mind I do have a large bust. I did love all the color and the ruffles on this top though! It is definitely an eye-catcher and will get you lots of compliments!
This was a little longer than I expected, hitting me at the knees. It was definitely roomy, but very comfortable. I think a 2 would have fit me better.

i'm typically a 4 in theory dresses, but went with the 2 in this cape and it was perfect. i have rather broad shoulders and found that it fit just fine. the material feels and looks a bit like fleece. i thought it wld be more of a suit jacket or wool coat feel/material so my expectations were off. i would use this more casually, but if i had a suit underneath i may hesitate depending on the material. that being said, i can't wait to wear it with my jeans and other more casual outfits!

i'm typically a 4, but always a 2 in theory shift dresses so the 2 for this dress fit well. hit a couple of inches above the knee so it was perfect for work. the sleeves were a nice touch so was the v back. the dress was nice, but not wow on me. my friend that's taller looks much better in the dress so i would recommend this for taller ppl, but it's fine for shorter gals, too.

I wore this to a formal dinner party. The fabric was a rich brocade, heavy without being stiff. It has pockets, which I kind of think of as a negative since one shouldn't be at a formal party with your hands in your pockets, but it did not add any awkwardness to the dress. This is really the perfect cocktail dress for a winter event. It was very comfortable. It was definitely big. I normally wear a 2 or 4, but got a 4 and 6 because the last set of dresses I got (a 2 and 4), the 4 was too small. The 4 fit well enough. A 2 would have been better, but all in all, I was very satisfied.
Rides up a bit and larger through midsection

I ended up not wearing this because the plans changed.  However, I wish I had something else to wear it to that weekend because it was super sexy.  I wasn't sure if I should click runs large or not.  The bottom fit great, but the top was a little large- and that is rare for me (and the smaller size, the bottom was tight but the top was ok).  It's possible the size 4 I had was just overworn and stretched out.

I am usually a size 2  but ended up wearing the 4.  My daughter wore the extra same dress I ordered in the size 2 and she is usually a 4.  It was a little big on her but think mine fit perfectly.  I love the high low back.
Cute dress, but the fit kind of made me look like a tent.

Definitely not for the small chested girls. Which was precisely why I chose it and it was perfect. I wore it with a velvet choker to soften the leather look and a side sweep faux hawk. It was pretty jaw dropping.

This was my back up dress and I ended up liking it more than my planned dress. It was perfect for a holiday party. I felt pretty, classy, and still comfortable. The dress does run big, I typically wear an 18 and wore a 16 easily. It is prettier than it looks, from the pictures my husband thought it was flat out ugly but he loved it on! Thank you Rent the Runway! 
Oh, also plan on wearing a strapless bra...

I intially rented this dress in a size 0L to wear to a Marine Corps Ball. After a slight panic about sizing issues once I placed my order, I contacted customer service about adding the 0R (I'm 5'5 1/2 and wasnt sure about shoes yet). The young lady was very helpful and made me more confident in my rental. I'm currently 118lbs and the 0 fit nice, but not as snug as a usual 0 when I'm 5lbs smaller (probably due to the fact that there is so much STRETCH in the fabric). The regular was a good length, but I wore the long for my event because it made the slight train in back more prominent.
This dress exceeded my expectations! It's soo sparkley!!! I received compliments from the time I exited the car at valet, to the many stops on the evelator ride with hotel guess waiting to get on & sneaking a peak as I stood at the door's opening, to arriving at the ball room & other young ladies there complimenting me, even while standing on the curb waiting on our car at the end of the night! I paired this dress gold strappy shoes, red polish &  the necole miller accessories, southern plantation earings and the star light star bright bracelet and necklace...PERFECT!
This is not the dress for you if you aren't a fan of stares and attention! 
My only complaints are that I'm a 32D & still needed to wear a bra for good clevage, this dress offers no support and my chest and inner arms were irritated by the scratching of the sequin by the 3rd hour of wear but It was well worth it!
I'm currently planning my next rental.
Really cute shirt! Looks good with formal pants and also with a shorter skirt to go out. Loved it!

this dress is a stunner. I rented it as an extra dress. It was completely gorgeous, I just ended up wearing the one I'd planned to wear. Upon seeing it in my closet, a bunch of friends were like, "woah this is beautiful". I'm a 34DD, ~135lbs, 5'9" and the 6 fit. I possibly could have fit in the 4. The top was a bit roomie, but I didn't try it on with a strapless bra and should have. The dress does accommodate a strapless or low bra. I recommend.
This fit awesome in the chest (I'm 34E), but was loose in the waist. Beautiful dress, would buy to own. Nice thick material. The pockets are a nice touch.

Loved the 'look' style. Which that it had been a bit more fitted through the middle but it was comfortable and if you like a bit of that flowing romantic look more than super tailored this might work for you. If I rent again I might try a small instead. Normally I get mediums because of my chest size but I think the stretch in the fabric would forgive them and still let me have a little better fit in the waist.
The dress looked great, but the dress was loose in the bust area.
Loved the dress, it was a little large in the chest for me but still great
The sequins were scratching  my underarms all night.  Unless your arms are stick thin, they will rub against the dress and it hurts! my underarms were red and scratched up for days.
The top portion was a bit large and gappy.

I love this dress. I wore the pink version for my first bridal shower and the green for my second shower. The color is outstanding! Pairs great with a statement necklace. Very comfortable and flattering.

The details of this dress are just classic and pretty; I loved the lace neckline and color.  It was the perfect party dress- fun but elegant and I got complements the whole night!  I usually wear an 8, but the 8 wasn't available so I decided to give the 6 a try since people said it runs big- and it fit like a glove- however I will say if you have a larger bust- the extra room of the 8 would have been nice.  Would rent this dress again!

A nice light-weight casual style for summer. I am typically a size 8 or 10, and could have worn the size 6, I had a lot of extra room. The style was right above my knees, and I wore it to work with white Keds. I definitely recommend going one size down for the backup. Lots of compliments on this fun patterned dress with  zodiac signs!

This dress is incredibly flattering - I styled with navy wedges, simple gold pendant and bright pink lip. To be honest, it looks much better in photos than in person. The fabric comes off more home spun than elegant, but in photos it is a knock out! It was comfortable and ran a bit big. One of the sizes I got had a sash, the other did not. I thought it looked much better with the sash. I wore a nude bra underneath and didn't think too much about whether or not my bra straps were visible - they certainly aren't noticeable in photos.

The dress is beautiful, I love the soft pink color and how flattering it was on me.  However the top was large (which usually never happens, I have a large bust) so I found myself pulling it down all night to try to ensure a better fit.  Overall, I loved it but most likely wouldn't rent it again.  The pockets were fun!

The dress does run overall large, especially in shoulder/chest area. The color was beautiful but the material was a bit thin and hugged every imperfection. I think this dress may be better for tall ladies and those with longer torsos!

This dress is wonderful - makes you look skinny and has nice details.  I have LARGE hips and thighs, and a small waist, so I sized up to a 10 from my normal 8.  This fit but was a little on the tight side around the thighs.  Got a lot of compliments.

Loved this dress, and the fabric stretched to my figure so I imagine it works for most shapes. However as with most dresses, my hourglass shape means it's a little bigger on top and tight on the bum. Still looked nice, and I received lots of compliments!

I wasn't able to wear this because I couldn't come close to  zipping the small up! (I am between a 4 and 6 in dress size.) The fabric is heavy/high quality and the color is darker than in the photo. I plan on renting a larger size because it would be a perfect work skirt for fall.
Runs really small.  I typically wear a 6 and I ordered the 8 and 10.  Wound up with the 8 and it was definitely form fitting but not in an unflattering way.  Great color.

I didn't love this dress. The 6 for better than the 8 in the shoulders and I still had to fashion tape the shoulders on. The bottom half was too tight for my liking in a 6 but the overall for was better in a 6. I also rented the same silhouette and wore it the next night in beige/silver and it was beautiful on camera.

I wore this to a comedy show in Chicago. The dress fabric is heavy and runs small overall. My best friend described the dress as  different, but very stylish. I will definitely rent this slimming, but conservative dress again.
I wore this dress to a formal dance for adults and I felt young and hip in it.

Great dress, lots of compliments! I'm 5'9" and could have used a bit more length even though I ordered the L size. It is a very tight-fitting dress, I decided to go up one size from my regular size just so it would feel a little more comfortable.

I wore this for my engagement party and it was such a hit. At 6ft tall, it was about 1 inch too long in flats, and I found myself tripping over it a few times when walking up steps. I would say that it fit me perfectly, a tad snug to zip up, but once zipped it didn't cause any back butt or those pesky underarm wings and I wasn't worried about it slipping down. I'd say if you're much larger than a 36D, the zip-up might be a serious struggle, the zipper is a hidden one and hard to grip. All things considered, beautiful dress that I highly recommend, it would be fantastic for a wedding or more formal affair.

This jacket is probably my favorite piece I've gotten from RTR. It goes with practically everything! It's formal enough to be worn with business or cocktail attire, but also super cute over jeans and a tee. I love multi-use items, and this was perfect for me. It's a great design, and looks edgy and fun without losing elegance. Perfect!

If you are looking for a dress unlike any other, choose this gorgeous clover canyon!  I was drawn to this dress because it was form fitting but not black!  Be ready for compliments because this is a dress that not many people have seen before.  Due to it being form fitting, it feels very tight on the skin, so I would recommend Spanx if possible.  Lastly, the colors of this dress make all accessories and shoes possible.  Love this dress.

So it's short!!! But I love it!!! It's also super low!!! But that doesn't bother me either!!! My only complaint is that the arms are awkwardly short. And you can't pull it up at all. I wish it was either 3/4 sleeve or full sleeve. But it's a great dress!!!

Loved this dress! The reviews are accurate-the dress runs small.  I could squeeze into the small but it was not as classy of a fit as the Medium. Also, the Medium was more comfortable and forgiving! Gorgeous color and super flattering! A must rent!

Low cut and was a bit tight in the bust area for me because I have a broader back and may be a bit bustier than the ladies the cut of the dress was intended for, but it's a darling dress that has a slight sheen and just really looks glam and edgy at fun all at the same time. And since the skirt is fuller, no need for spanx.

This dress is amaze. Parker is always spot on with great quality and color. I wore this dress for a bachelorette weekend with the girls. I ordered up from my usual size and I'm glad I did. The large was nicely fitted but not constricting tight on me. It zipped smoothly but had I ordered the medium I don't think it would have fit. The dress was still a mini on me which is a plus but tall girls beware. Also if you have large breast order up. My "girls" were a little stuffed in there. I felt beautiful and sexy in this dress. My boyfriend loved it.

This dress is gorgeous. I rented it for my engagement photos. Typically I wear a size 6 (I'm 5'3", 135 lbs.) so I ordered this in a size 6R with a backup size of 10R (they were out of size 8R on my dates), but I am SO glad I did. This dress runs really small, especially for busty girls like myself (34DD). I ended up wearing the 10R, which fit perfectly. The dress hugs in all the right spots and is very flattering. Just be sure to size up one to two sizes from your typical size, especially if you are at all busty or curvy.

I normally wear an 8,  but the lining of the 8 was so tight around the butt, hips and thighs. If I stood there, the dress appeared to fit perfect, but underneath, yikes, I couldn't sit or walk.
I wore the 10, and had plenty of room
In the chest and I'm a 34D. 
Overall I loved this dress! I thought the cap sleeves would bother me, but all around the dress was very comfortable, and was very nice quality! Pockets are very cute as well. Got complements all night, and many girls were excited to hear about RTR! Yay!

I loved the lace detail especially in the back.  The dress hit right above the knee and gave room to breathe. I normally wear an 8 but wore a 10 in this one after seeing reviews commenting on the dress being tight in the bust and arm area & I'm glad I did.   The dress was suggested to me by a RTR stylist and it worked out great!

I wore this dress to a fundraising event. My only real complaint was that it ran small in the arms and shoulders which is mentioned in the other reviews. I pretty much always wear a 12 so to feel restricted in a 14 was very strange for me. Overall the dress was pretty, it just didn't wow me like my other rentals have.

Pros- beautiful color and great quality fabric
Cons- it is actually a mermaid fit, which I did not like. I wish I could have replaced the dress with something else. Great dress, but not flattering.

Pros: A stunning turquoise, thick high quality fabric that even hid any "lumps" one might see from my lace bra. It is great for hugging curves and even though it was tight, I felt pretty in it. 
Cons: It ran on the small side...in the chest specifically...thus I wore a lace bra to "minimize" padding and still ended up with a "uniboob." Also, you can see a "normal" bra strap the way the arms are cut. Finally, because it runs small the slit in the back will hike up too. Recommend getting your size and one size up to be safe. I'm an 8/10 but if I had the 12 it would have been perfect. I would rent again in the 12. 

I'm unlimited (LOVING IT) so this was just something to try. I threw a long crochet sweater over it to dress it down and wore it to a birthday brunch. I received several compliments.

I got so many compliments on this gorgeous Mara Hoffman dress.  Felt sexy, but still comfortable.  The dress accentuates the smallest part of your waist, which is super flattering, but is also flowy and comfortable.  I liked that it is a little shorter (hits around the ankles) so it wasn't dragging all night and you could see my shoes.  However, if you are taller (I'm 5'4), it might seem a little highwater-ish.  Also, I normally wear a 6  but the material is not forgiving or stretchy, so I went up to the 8 and would recommend ordering a back up size up.

I normally wear a size 4-6 in dresses, however, I had to go a size up to the 8R due to the tightness in the rib cage. The size 6R fit, I just was not comfortable in it. Due to sizing up, the 8R straps were a little loose and I had to get a friend to safety pin them in the back so it looked like part of the dress. Love the pockets of the dress, and overall I got many compliments on the dress. One other con was that even with double sided tape near the cleavage area, the material kept turning outward maybe from it being worn too much. Overall it was a great fit for the vineyard wedding in VA!

This dress was perfect for the summer wedding I attended! I ordered the size 6 and 8, but I have a very short torso and the size 8 provided me with a little extra length there. I usually wear a size 6, so I feel like it ran a little small, but I tend to wear a different size depending on the brand so I would say depending on your body type to either size up or stay true to your size. I loved the length of the dress, it was so classy. The tulle underneath the skirt makes it really flare out and gives the dress such a cute shape. I would recommend this dress to anybody! P.S. ignore the boots I'm wearing!

The fit was a bit small, so I ended up wearing the 8, as I have wider set hips. I also felt the dress was a bit short on me, as I am 5'9, but just it was so fun and so different that I had people complimenting me all night long.

I usually wear 10-12. I wore the 10L and it was a little big, but it looked great!  I got the Long because I wanted to be able to switch to flats later in the evening and not have them be seen. The length was just right for both heels and flats.  I imagined the sequins to more silvery but they were a beautiful rose gold color. I was at a huge party with lots of bling-y dresses and this was by far one of the best- the color in person is so much much prettier than the picture. The dress has a uber comfortable lining so you don't feel sequins scratching you all night long. It feels like you are wearing a night gown! This dress is feminine, sexy and elegant.  It was a winner for me and I received so many compliments. I would rent it again.

I loved this gown.  It was the perfect dress to wear for the presidential inauguration.  The material was great but I wish I had ordered a size smaller because it was way too big on me.  I also could've used an extra inch or two on my heels because it was a bit long.  Still, great dress and I highly recommend it for anyone going to a formal affair.

This dress is a basic piece that allowed me to add accessories and spruce up a bit.  It does run very large and I probably could have went down another size (I'm typically 4 or 6).  The material is nice and thick, the dress doesn't wrinkle.  The top portion of the dress had an odd fit, but I imagine women with a larger chest wouldn't have this problem.  I am only 5'3" and the dress fell well below my knees.  Probably not one that I'd rent again.

Ah, this top is so versatile and gorgeous! It's a breathable fabric, but structured so that there is no need to wear anything under it. It's long - great for me with a long torso - and the gold is a really beautiful. I dressed this up and down, and was sad to return it. I will absolutely rent again. It runs roomy by design/intention, so size down for your back-up.  (I'm 5'9, currently 10/12 in photo, 36D)

The dress was beautiful! I wore it to the Marine Corp Ball and it was perfect for the event. I felt so beautiful and walked with confidence in this dress!!! I will say though that I wish I had ordered it a size smaller. I picked my size based on the size chart suggestions for my waist size and while the dress did fit pretty well I could have worn a size smaller and showed off more of my curves. I suggest ordering based on your bust size. Also, I got the long since I am 5'8 and wore 3 inch heels and the dress was still a little too long, so I recommend either wearing at least 5 inch heels or ordering the regular if you are on the taller side.
Fit was big but it made it comfortable; the 8/46 was not available. Eye-catching cut-out/shoulder. Length was just below knee. Burgundy color not flashy, more classic.

I wore this to a gala in Palm Beach. In a sea of typical cocktail dresses this stood out in a great way. I was with co-workers and I felt comfortable sitting across from my boss and still sexy for my husband :) This dress is long, I am very tall and you can see where it hit my knees. Also, the mid section is a little loose, I would have preferred to have it tighter around my waist it made me look a little puffy there, but overall I loved the dress <3

I rented the small after reading that the dress ran large and the small fit me perfectly. The dress is pretty heavy but feels nice and flow-y. I loved the color for a fall occasion. Wanted to keep it!

I was so sad that I didn't get to wear this dress. I rented a pink and black dress as the Maid of Honor for the Bachelorette party had yet to make a color decision. This dress fits wonderful, hip hugging and sexy! It is long though, I would have definitely pinned it up. I am going to rent again as soon as the occasion arises.

This dress is amazing and it looked so well in photos! I wore it to prom and got tons of compliments. It runs large, so definately size down for a good fit. I wear a 6 and the medium was too big; the small fit like a glove! I'm a 36C and it fit perfect around the bust area. It has a slit knee- high which is a wow factor. Nonetheless, lovely glown.
definitely runs large, I could have likely worn a smaller size. Due to the shape of the sweater, it didn't make a big difference.

This is the perfect dress for anyone tall. Because of the high-low hem line, I never felt like I was about to accidentally flash everyone at any given moment. This dress does run a little big, so I would recommend going down a size. The red is well represented in the picture and provides the perfect amount of pop.

When I first took this dress out of the garment bag, I was a bit concerned. However, I was happy to see it looks better on than on the hanger. It is very warm and looked nice with navy tights. It did run a big large though. There was too much room in the bust (I'm a 32B) and the sleeves were much too long. I was able to roll them under though, and they stayed that way pretty well.

I ordered a 10 and an 8 since this was my first time renting and the 8 worked out great! I am between an 8 and 10 right now and the 8 wasn't too loose up top like the 10 had been and was still super comfy. If you're planning to eat/drink a lot at the event you're going to, this dress is definitely for you. It is very forgiving.

Dress was gorgeous but far too big and I unfortunately couldn't wear it . It looked like a sack on me. I would recommend ordering a few sizes smaller than our normal. If it were to fit, it would have been my favorite dress
I thought that the S was a little big, especially in the top half, so I had to pin it.
The color is more vibrant in person, its gorgeous.  I ordered a size larger and the smaller ended up being the better fit.  This dress is so comfortable and I got so many compliments on it.
More ivory than white. The skirt is incredible, so much movement. I do recommend wearing a slip and a light bra. Paired with a statement necklace, this dress is fantastic. I got so many compliments!

This made me feel gorgeous. It was comfortable for formal wear. I should’ve gone a size down but it was so lovely, sexy, and classy. I wish this were a part of my personal wardrobe. You won’t regret it

This dress was gorgeous but can't say I loved it. It is definitely better for a summer event than during the colder months. I wore it with tights and it was cute, but I would have liked it much better without. The silhouette is flattering but I wish it had more of a shape. It is more of a shift dress..

It was heavy and fit very large, but we flattering.  I'm 5'10 I usually wear a 10 and went with the 8L I also didn't wear heels because it was a little short when I added the heels. The hanger pieces kept falling out throughout the night so tuck those in well or use tape.

This dress does run large, so even though I was nervous about getting my back-up size in a 4 (rather than an 8), I was glad I did! The 6 was much too big and the 4 fit perfectly, with plenty of extra room in the waist. Definitely required a petal/sticky bra which i bought for $30 at target. Also the color was beautiful. Looks much darker on the model than it was in real life. The back of this dress is gorgeous. I got many compliments throughout the night -- Wish I owned this one!

I only got to wear this dress for a half hour before I learned of a family emergency and had to leave my event but I got many compliments right away. I typically wear a 16/18 and the 16W was a bit loose in the top but I wouldn't have gone smaller than the 16. RTR customer service was so helpful in overnighting me a 16WL because the regular was too short for the heels I found to wear. The mystery bling they sent were beautiful crystal black drop earrings and they matched perfectly and looked great with an updo. The only con was the sequins rubbing under my arm. As I said I only wore the dress for a short time but my arms were still red and slightly irritated the next day. I knew this was typical for sequined dresses however, and this beauty was worth the pain. I would definitely rent this dress again for another event.

Great dress, awesome color and fit. The 0 was a bit big on me, mostly because I don't have the boobs to fill it out all the way. Still looked great, and was super comfortable. Photographs well. Would totally recommend!

I wore this to a black tie gala. It wasn't too formal and I got several compliments on it. The service through RTR was also excellent, my only (small) issue is that the dress was a little big in the chest. Nothing some fashion tape couldn't fix!
This was my "back-up"- it was too tight for me through the bust and ribs. As a result, it felt too short in the front. I ended up wearing the Marchesa I also ordered.

I loved this dress! The color is very bright and bold - I got lots of compliments! It looks heavy but the material is actually fairly light.  I usually wear a 4 in everything, but this 4 was a little tight. I could have worn it but the 6 just gave a little extra room.

I LOVED this dress. I received non-stop compliments throughout the night. It was the perfect dress for the garden wedding I attended. It was light, airy, and one-of-a-kind. I have had issues previously with dresses being too short and the asymmetrical tea length of this dress was really nice. Side note: I was so happy I ordered both the Medium and Large. I ended up wearing the Large as the Medium was REALLY tight around my chest and ribs, which is an area I would describe as "smaller" on me. If you're in between sizes, get your backup size one size up.

I wore this dress to a summer, country club wedding and received a TON of compliments. Overall the dress fit well but I did size up as the small was too tight around my butt/thighs and there isn't any stretch. The color was really pretty and somewhere between pale blue and lavender. I was weary about it being too light/close to white for a wedding but the color definitely came through. The dress was comfortable, easy to dance in, and very flattering. I definitely recommend it!
The fit was strange! It was not very comfortable either. But I am overall satisfied with this look and I'm looking forward to my next rental in May! :)

I rented this for a black tie wedding and I loved it! I usually wear a 4 or 6. I couldn't even get the 4 over my hips but the 6 fit great. I'm only 5'4" so I was worried it would be too long but it was perfect with 3 inch heels. Make sure you have a sticky bra, as the sides are narrowly cut. The color and details of the flowers were even prettier in person!

I can usually wear a 0 or 2 but for this dress both made me uncomfortable. I have large hips and a larger butt for my size and it was definitely showing in this dress, that coupled with the short length made me feel less confident in the dress so i returned it.  If hip hugging is what you are going for, this is the dress for you! If you prefer a more conservative cut, I'd skip it.

This dress is pretty and I received a lot of compliments.  I was in a house party during an August wedding so it was a very nice choice for a black dress in summer!  However, as others said, it runs very tight in the shoulders. I would normally wear a 4 in this shape of dress but had to size up to a 6 so I could move my arms around.  I could easily pinch out an inch or 2 around my waist since I was wearing the bigger size.

Dress run small. I am normally a 4 and I wore the 6. Will be tight at first and as the night goes it loosens,. Not too much but a little around the thighs and knees in thighness from standing and walking and dance all night.
Beautiful dress but it unfortunately came with a rip near the zipper--- had to use saftey pins to keep it together, as it was too last minute to order a replacement.

I rented this dress for a gala and it was beautiful.  I loved the fabric.  My only issue with this dress was the fit.  There is almost no stretch at all to the fabric so it was really tight on my hips, but really loose on the top.  I had to wear Spanx to get the dress on and double sided tape to keep the top from hanging down so I felt pretty uncomfortable all night.  The length was good with some heels which is good because I'm really short.

This dress is really gorgeous on, and I love the sheen to it. I'm 5' 11", and the length was about mid-thigh, which is good considering most other above-the-knee dresses hit shorter. While I know I'm pear shaped, I could not step into the dress without causing much stress on the bottom of the zipper, so I needed to pull it on over my head. That being said, there's plenty of room once on for my hips, bottom, and thighs, though the lining underneath was considerably shorter (and nearly pointless) by the time it made it over all of that for me. The chest area was extremely tight on me, and I do not have a large chest at all -- this is the only reason I marked this as running "small." Many times in dresses of similar styles I've been able to size down two sizes. However, when I tried the 8 on, I couldn't zip the back once at chest level. Still, although it was stiff, the dress in the 10 looked great on and was very flattering.

The fit was perfect! A little in the back because it's open but didn't bother me.  Love this dress and was so pleased it fit perfectly since i ordered it 2 days before i needed to wear it and didnt even get a backup size bc they were out.

The dress runs small. I wore mine for about 30 minutes the day before to loosen up the 4. The 6 was just too loose in certain spots. I am 5'11" and 145lbs. I am thin but have a butt so if you have broad hips or a butt I would definitely recommend wearing the dress a bit before the event.
Fit was great, ran a little big at the top which wasn't an issue for me.

This shirt was a mid drift shirt on me so it's better on shorter torsos or someone who doesn't mind showing some tummy.  I saw another review which said the bow is shorter than pictured, the shirt comes with a separate piece of fabric that is in a pouch that you use to create the long look you see if the picture by tying it with the bow on the shirt.

The dress does definitely run small. I'm usually a 2L and the 4L was snug.  I did rent both sizes, but in addition to the 2L being very tight, the zipper was completely impossible to zip up due to the way the fabric bunches in that area.  The 4L zipper was challenging, but OK once I figured out the trick to it.  
I wore this dress, and one other from RTR, for my new jazz show featuring the music and clubs of the 1930s and 40s.  It was gorgeous on stage, very flattering, and still allowed me to breathe correctly, which some formal gowns do not.  I received more compliments than I could count.

I would recommend only going with a long size if you are over 5'8".  I'm 5'8" and even in three-inch heels, it dragged the floor.  It wasn't an issue, but was definitely on the long side.

Everyone said the dress ran large, so I rented a 4 with a size 2 as my backup. I tried on the 4, and it was super tight in the ribcage area. It's funny because my hips are the larger part of me, not my bust. They overnighted me a size 6, which fit perfectly in the ribcage. It was quite loose in the chest, so I safety-pinned it together. It also was longer than I thought it would be. The sequins did not bother my skin at all.

I loved wearing this to a cocktail party at an art museum.  It's simple, sexy, and such a fun color to wear.  It does run on the small side so I wore the 12.  It is also ultra fitted and will certainly show everything.   The cut at the neck and shoulders is very flattering; I went without a necklace to show it off.  I paired with super tall orange heels and pearl earrings.  Can't wait to rent again!

The dress seems quite a bit shorter than it looks on the model, though I am by no means tall. You might also expect a tight fit through the midsection. Plan to wear tights if you enjoy sitting down over the course of a day!
This dress is so beautiful! The color is perfect for any event.. It runs small, I'm not used to wearing tight dresses so I had to go a size up... I LOVED IT!

Wore this to chaperone Prom at my school. The dress is pretty but runs small (The bodice was tight). It has pockets and overall the dress is flattering. I wasn't in love with it because of the fit, but the color was beautiful. I am 5'1" so the skirt hit me below the knee. Beautiful red color.

I rented this for my engagement party. This would be a great bachelorette party dress. It looks a little blue in pictures but it's white in person. Very blingy with all the sequins. After a while of rubbing up against your arms by your side it gets a little uncomfortable. And the dress is really small and tight and short. I usually wear a 0 and ended up wearing a 4 to feel comfortable.

The fabric is very thick and doesn't stretch much at all.  It was a cold night so it was perfect, but I wouldn't recommend for a summer night.  The fit ran a little small, but overall was a great option for my night out!

This dress was definitely a hit! I received so many compliments on the dress, and I felt beautiful in it. I wore a size 6L, which fit me well, aside from a short struggle with the zipper. My measurements are 35-28-38.
Ran very large. Had to belt. Not fitted at all in the waist. Wear a 4 in Lilly and Kate and was swimming in this 4.

Beautiful dress!! Super comfortable but definitely runs big.  I usually wear a 6/8 and the 6 was WAY too big.  So glad I listened to other reviewers and sized way down.  The 4 ended up fitting perfectly!  The material is pretty thick so it may be too warm on a hot summer day.  But it was perfect for my May bridal shower!

Wore this for a holiday party. I sized down based on reviews and I'm so glad I did. One size down hugged my curves perfectly. The dress has a great amount of stretch. It's not super fancy-looking so I was able to wear it to a festive holiday gathering without feeling overdressed.

Like others have mentioned this dress runs LARGE. Like seriously, I rarely have worn an XS as an adult. With that said, a few well-placed safety pins sinched the waist and gave a flattering figure. The dress is very comfortable and flowy. A great midi dress for me being 5'8"ish. Might be a little too long on someone shorter. All-in-all though I loved this dress!

Dress fit well, like any other Lilly dress. I checked the Lilly website to help with sizing and picked the correct size. I usually wear a 4 in dresses, but Lilly runs a little big, so I went with a 2 and it fit nicely. I have a regular body shape and think this would be flattering on most people. The exception being tall people. The dress is short. I'm 5'2 and it was lovely on me. But I think it might be very short on those over 5'5. Material is thick and doesn't cling; I liked the texture of the dress also.

I wore this dress for a work anniversary party.  It was comfortable and looked great with tights and booties.  It did run bigger than I thought it would.  I tried it belted, but ended up just going with the loose look!
Would recommend sizing down for backup.

Pros: The pattern is truly unique. I received tons of compliments on it when I wore this out to dinner. The change in hemline is interesting too.
Cons: It definitely seems like it should be a summer dress, but the fabric is quite heavy. It also wrinkles easily.

I normally wear a medium but in this dress I was able to perfectly fit the small.  I wore this from work straight to a ribbon cutting and it worked out perfectly in both places.  there is a shear underlying that covers the view of your undergarments from the shear overlay of the top layer of fabric.  Very classy
Ran large but the RTR stylist helped with sizing. Added a headband for a belt. Couldn't find a belt I liked!!

The material of this dress is incredibly flattering. The material is thick enough that it hides imperfections. I received compliments all night. I wore it to a black-tie wedding in the winter. I paired it with a black faux-fur shawl. This dress is cut short, so I would recommend considering a long. Otherwise, your entire shoe may show.
This fits a little on the larger size, but I didn't mind.  However, when I rent this again, I will probably size down.

Loved this dress! Beautiful quality and colors. Photographs really well! I sized down and wore it off the shoulder and really liked the way that looked. If you have a smaller upper body (even with a big booty) you can size down, I wore a much smaller size than I would recommend and it turned out fine but that was more because what was available that day not best fit.

This dress was great for my company gala - a real statement dress that turned out to be a real show stopper.  RTR delivered at the last minute because my other rentals of choice (Sweet as Candy and Faye Chiffon gowns) didn't fit - and it turns out I was GLAD that they didn't fit because two other women wore the Faye Chiffon at my event. At least one of them was another RTR user! :)

It ran long, and honestly I felt it was a little large but I am between sizes right now. I am 5'4" and wore 3" heels, and I still had to lift the dress to walk around comfortably. I think it looked incredibly elegant, despite the extra length.  If a 16 petite had existed, it would have been perfect for me.

Thank you, RTR, for saving the day and making me look and feel like a million bucks!

New Years in New Jersey is typically pretty cold and this year was even more frigid than usual which made me extra happy that I chose this coat when I decided that I needed/wanted a long "fur" coat to keep me warm over the holiday weekend.  The small was unavailable, so I got the medium.  It ran SLIGHTLY large/oversized, but I loved it like that. (Sleeves were a little long and back not super fitted)  I wore it every day I had it and was super sad to return it.  Best fancy coat to wear in any winter vortex.

I usually wear an 8 but because of the flowing nature of it over my larger hips I chose the 6. I have narrow shoulders and a small bust.  The top fit like a glove so I could forget about what I was wearing and just enjoy it.  The best part is the skirt!  Flows around you like water when you walk or dance.  Fun!

Like most Equipment shirts, this one runs big. I normally would wear a Small, but I know that Equipment fits me best in XS. I wore this shirt with olive colored pants for a casual work lunch, but it's definitely versatile and would brighten a lot of outfits with this fun summery pattern.
