at the suggestion of my friend, i rented from the runway. after my event, i learned that we had selected the same dress. i'm normally a 12, though easily fit into the 10 (the bust was a bit too big for me so i had to saftey pin it in); while my friend is a 4. we both looked stunning in our dresses (we went to different events). i definitely think this dress looks great on just about every girl, every shape & every age. it's classic, comfortable and a head turner.

I wore this dress for a rehearsal dinner of a wedding I was a bridesmaid in and it was so comfortable! I wore the 6 but could've even worn a 4! So I would recommend going down a size for your backup.  The color is so beautiful in person and has just the right amount of sparkle.  There are snaps at the shoulder to hold your bra straps in place which is wonderful because I hate having to wear a strapless bra!  The full skirt made the dress very comfortable but my favorite thing about it is that it has pockets!!  Absolutely loved this dress and received so many compliments!  Would definitely rent it again!
Runs very large!  Size down by 2 sizes.  The neckline is very tricky.  If your chest is over a B cup be prepared to use duct tape to pull them up and out ;).

This dress is amazing. It is remarkably comfortable, I ordered a 4 and a 2 and ended up wearing the 2 because it fit my shoulders better. The only thing that I didn't really like was that the back zipper went all the way down to the bottom of the dress and kept getting caught when I sat down. But I would definitley order this dress again!
I received a lot of compliments on the print of this dress but wasn't crazy about it myself.  The colors appeared a little faded, possible from one too many washes and the fit was overall too large.

I absolutely loved this dress, it was just unfortunate that it kept riding up. I would occasionally look down and the dress would have folded up across my stomach which may be due to the very thick material (a much better outcome than if the hemline were to scrunch up). Most likely won't be an issue for ladies who wear a better fitted piece. Recommend sizing down. Got many compliments throughout the night.

Thank goodness they were out of 2s in the back up size because I ended up wearing the 0, which even still was a little large and almost tent-like. Had it been a perfect fit, I would have been able to get away with a low set strapless bra. Still, it was perfect for the 85 degree weather.

This was a great, modest dress. The color was amazing! I got so many compliments for it. I ordered a size smaller than I usually get and it fit great. I also wore a belt around it which added a great finishing touch.
If your chest is smaller, definitely plan to add padding!

Loved this dress. Very comfortable and great length for summer. True to size, except runs small in the bust area. I most always wear size 0, but had a back up size 2, and ended up wearing it because the bust area was so tight. You will love this dress.

Ended up wearing the larger of the two I got, and it was still small in the chest. I needed a little extra help getting it zipped, and was starting to get uncomfortable by the end of the night. But everywhere else it fit great. The color was a little more pink than I expected, but still very beautiful, and got lots of compliments.
I normally wear a XS but this dress runs a little tight so I ended up wearing the S.

Love the back of this dress! I wore it as a bridesmaid dress and it was stunning. My only complaint is that the back of the dress makes it really hard to find a good pair of spanx to wear with it. I am pretty tall with heels and felts that the dress dragged a lot on the floor. Overall, I would rent this dress again.

My daughter wore this for a semi-formal Homecoming dance. She is 5’4” and had to wear the smaller of the 2 sizes, even though it was a little tight across her rib cage to keep the front in place. The straps were too long, so we ended up having to pin them. That being said, the dress was gorgeous and she loved it. She is normally a size 0, and the xs was tight across her ribs.

I had to wear this skirt pretty highup on my ribs to cinch it shut, but I had great posture for the rest of the day because I was aware of every time I slouched in this. It has a nice weight to it and holds its shape well, and it has pockets that can fit a cell phone!
Beautiful cut. It's a great length on anyone. It runs small but hold you in nicely. I needed help getting it zipped but once I was in, I was fine.

Beautiful dress.. but definitely needed to size up! I am a 2 and had to wear the 4, which was still tight. Also, the top was a bit loose, would look better on women with a larger bust (I am 34B). I would still highly recommend though!
If I lose some weight would order again.
The size two fit, but I decided to wear the size four. It fit better through the hips.

I'm short (5'3) and this was a very flattering length (a couple of inches above the knee, but still work appropriate). Good fit through shoulders, bust and hips, but tight across the ribs. Will try the next size up.
The dress was pretty but I may have gotten a size too small so it fit pretty sung. I would definitely go a size up. it is a lycra material so very snug to the body.

FITS SMALLY IN THE ARMS 
TRUE TO SIZE EVERYWHERE ELSE

So many compliments! This was a perfect dress for a dressy party and a casual party the same night. Comfortable, with some stretch. I had to size up because the ribcage runs small, and the zipper is super hard to pull up- my husband had a hard time & I could not have gotten it by myself. Was fine pulling down. I wore with tall boots during a snowy night, but it would look beautiful with dressy sandals.

First, I would like to say THANK YOU to the reviewers who recommended going up 1-2 sizes. I am happy I did because the 2 was snug but the 4 fit comfortably (normally a 0 petite). 
Secondly, the top is small. I'm a 5'1, 108 lbs, 34C & my breasts spilled out of the dress. I had to rig the collar with a small binder clip to lift the top of the dress so that my boobs could fit!  (My long hair covered the small clip). I would not recommend this dress if you are top heavy. 
Lastly, the dress was worn with a dainty gold bracelet, gold studs & nude shoes. It is a beautiful, classy dress that doesn't need a lot of accessories.

Loved this dress and received so many compliments. It does run small. I normally wear a 0 and I squeezed into the 2, and it was tight. The top is very structured so you don't need a bra which is a plus. Very glamorous!
Beautiful and elegant dress.  Received endless compliments.  Perfect dress for an evening wedding.  The dress runs small so order one, or two, sizes larger.
Difficult to zip up.  Was stunning.  I am flat chested after double mastectomy, and dress was very flattering.

I wore this dress to a NYE wedding in the Northwest and it was the perfect combination of sparkle, class and warmth! I'm petite and the length of the dress was perfect, however, the fabric was on the thicker/heavier side so  just beware. Didn't stop me from dancing though!

I felt so beautiful in this dress and loved that it had pockets! The arms and waist are pretty tight, so I suggest sizing up, but everything fit perfectly up a size. I was a little nervous about renting this dress based on previous comments about the lace fraying, but honestly I couldn't tell except when I was scrutinizing because of those comments, so don't let that deter you! Overall fantastic dress, and even the back was fun. I would rent it again!

I really needed size 2 but unfortunately it was unavailable but since I had my heart set on this dress I got my usual size 0 and the next size available 4. 0 was too tight 4 was way too loose and hung on me awkwardly.  I made due with the 0 but on my walk home from the birthday party the slit split up more revealing my spanx. Definitely size up!! Even if in all the other dresses you've rented from RTR you've gone with a certain size like I had!

Pretty dress.  My backup size wasn't available.  I risked it and ordered the 4.  I couldn't zip it the whole way.  Size 4 in my back fit.  The lace is beautiful.  The color is a darker red.  Beautiful.

The colors in the dress are really vibrant, but the skirt is really flared out.  It's just an extremely substantive/voluminous dress for how fun and almost casual it looks in the pictures.  I ended up not wearing it but maybe others will have better luck.

I thought I would wear the 4 r, but ended up wearing the 6 p.  It was the perfect length for the 1-1/2" heels I was wearing, and the 4 r was just a little bit too tight, but would have worked if needed.

I've worn this DVF dress in a few different colors over the years and it's always great.  It's the right amount of sexy and traditional and can be dressed up or down for a variety of occasions.  I would definitely size up if you're on the edge.  The lace and darker color are relatively forgiving for this semi-snug dress.

I love this coat.  LOVE IT.   It's warm, but not overly thick, so really perfect for the fall.  It's shorter and wider than I expected, so it doesn't work with every outfit, but it's a great statement piece and fun to wear.

I rented this to participate in a Holiday benefit, and was excited about the cut based on the pictures. However, the ruffle was overwhelming, the cut wasn't terribly flattering, and the length was much too long for a petite frame. I would recommend this for much taller women. The darts were also in a strange place for me. The material was not as stretchy as I would have liked. 

I LIKE ruffles and have previously loved some of my rentals with dramatic ruffles, but this was too much for me. It looked less trendy and more matronly than it had on the model. The color is GORGEOUS and on the right body i'm sure this is lovely!

It fits a little large and baggy (im petite) but I didn't mind - it is super comfy and it looks chic paired with heeled ankle booties and a leather jacket for a cooler day in NYC. will definitely rent again, and possibly purchase

I wore this look to a black tie wedding (110' feels like temp!). It was perfect for the affair. It was a true show stopper. I received compliments all evening and felt like a princess. That being said, I was tugging on it all night. I have a small frame and bust, but after reading the reviews I thought that I would be okay from ordering the 2R. A lot of reviews stated to order a size up so I ordered the 4R as a backup. The 2R fit nicely on my ribs and torso, but I believe due to my (or lack thereof) chest, it was too big. I did everything I could to try and keep it up and fill in the gaps, but I wasn't as successful as I would have liked. I didn't have the same experience that everyone else was having with the tight boning in the ribcage. I was pretty self conscious about my gapping bust line, but it didn't stop me from dancing and enjoying myself. 

Even though this look was pretty big on me, I still would wear it again, just probably in a 0R or 2P! If you have a smaller bust, consider ordering a size down.
Wore this to a VMA afterparty and got so many compliments all night. I felt amazing in this dress!  Definitely runs large.  I usually wear a 2 or 4 but the 0 in this dress fit perfectly.

this dress was for sure too big... but it was nothing a little double sided tape and a sash could not fix. I AM IN LOVE WITH THIS DRESS. The material and the details are what make this dress such a stunner. I am hoping to buy it for myself with my next paycheck that is how much I LOVE THIS DRESS.
Wore it for an event and it was very tasteful
The top is awkward in the way that it lays. I was uncomfortable with the puckering near the cleavage area. The skirt part is amazing, so full and fun. It was shame that the top was so strange.

This dress was beautiful, but did run very large.  I would recommend sizing down one or two sizes. I am 5'4 and 115 lbs and the waistband on the dress was easily six inches too big.  I was able to make it work by pinning it in the back in several places (and it was clear I was not the first person to do so, as there was some damage to the dress where others had pinned it).  Due to the flowy nature of the dress, you could barely tell it was pinned.  I got so many compliments and just really loved the dress.  I would highly recommend, with the caveat that you must be prepared to make some of your own adjustments.
Runs large, and while its vivacious and sexy -- especially the color -- if you run small in size, the dress will make you look larger than you are.
Loved this dress! So sparkly and perfect for the benefit I attended.
Couldn't wear this because of the poor quality. The piling fabric made the dress look very worn. I could see that this dress was very popular because of the poor quality.

This dress runs really big... the straps kept falling down all night. Also, the elastic in the waistband felt like it had been stretched out, so it didn't really cinch in the waist like the picture shows. I wore this to a fraternity formal, and after dancing all night, the inside of my arms hurt from rubbing against the sequins!

When I first put this dress on,  I honestly wasn't sure about. The fit seemed off to me,  a little loose around my butt and stomach and the breast cups were horribly pointy. The bottom tulle is also a bit poofier than it looks in the picture. In the picture it also looks more gold and creamish, when it is actually a more gold and light beige-ish, though that wasn't a big deal.  I almost traded the size O for a 4 and am very glad I didn't as even the extra size 2 I had gotten was way too loose. 

BUT, I figured out that if I stuck a bra in between the part that held the cups up and the fabric the nipple pointyness went away.  With that gone the other unsureties seemed moot.  Once I had the whole ensemble together; hair,  makeup,  accessories,  this dress was absolutely GORGEOUS. The fit now seemed fantastic. The top part fit beautifully,  accentuating my petite hour glass shape and really making my breasts look great too. A lot of strapless gowns will have all that extra space,  but this one really hugged me and even gave me a little modest cleavage.  The fabric, color, and design is high quality and beautiful.  I am not exaggerating when I say I really had the most beautiful dress there.  I received several compliments,  and caught even more looking. 

I was really sad to take this dress off,  and even more sad to send it away.  I would love to own this dress.

I would definitely recommend getting two sizes in this, your normal size and one size up.  The 6 fit, but it was a little too tight.  They 8 was just right.  The lace detail was gorgeous and the best thing about the dress is how classy it looks, but being a romper is simultaneously comfortable.  Really loved this one and would consider renting it again.

Great dress for a winter wedding in February! I was worried that with my relatively flat chest that it wouldn't be flattering, but it turned out great, and I received compliments all night. The shoulder area is a little wide, so as a gal with shoulders that slope down, I had to keep popping the shoulders back on in order not to let the girls slip out!

I'm petite and the bust area was large on me. I wore it with a skinny black belt and necklace which added to the dress. Other than it running a little large on me, the fabric and look of the dress was great! It was for a more conservative event and so the covered top and longer length was perfect.

The fit is very boxy, even for my curves. I wear a size 8 in DVL wrap dresses, so I thought a medium would fit. Length was great (even for conservative work), at just above knee, but it swallowed me. I tried belting it but there was too much fabric. I think if I had gotten a small I would have been able to wear it. Color and fabric are great.

In a year where I attended no fewer than six weddings, this was one of my favorite dresses. It runs a little big, but it's one of the most charming, feminine, adorable shifts I've ever worn. I have pretty curvy hips, so it's often a bit difficult for me to wear shifts, but this one was perfectly cut and cute as a bug. I highly recommend a cute pixie haircut to wear with it, if you'd like to do your best Mia Farrow impression.
Nice substitute for your zipped hoodie or cardigan. The back is sweatsuit material so definitely has the workout wear look and feel.

I am 5'2  130lbs  and I ordered a size 0R and 2R. This dress runs a bit big and long. I ended up wearing the size 0 because it just hugged my body so well! I wore 5" heels and it was almost perfect length, except for when I was dancing I had to pick it up a bit so I wouldn't step on it, but I was doing a lot of turns. . .lol. The back opening was perfect because I was still able to wear a low back strapless bra. The only thing was that another girl had the same dress at the wedding!! Good thing I looked way better. .  . .hehehe.

The color is a prettier teal-blue in real life than in most photos. The shape is really flattering, especially with the adorable puff of tulle at the bottom - it starts low enough in the skirt to not add any fullness to the hips. Perfectly stylish for an outdoor wedding (at an antique barn).

So glad I ordered this as my backup dress since I ended up wearing this when my 1st option came in damaged.  Like most other reviewers said it runs a bit large, I normally wear a size 2 so I ordered the 2 and 0 as my backup. I ended up wearing the 0 as it fit perfectly! Is had great fullness in the skirt and super flattering, I got a ton of compliments on this one.  Would rent again if I needed a white dress.

Beautiful dress that ran slightly big in that the back would sometimes lift up and crumple. Definitely short and did ride up a bit when I walked. The hem at the bottom was pressed slightly off.  Otherwise, it was absolutely gorgeous - the colors were vibrant and I got compliments all night!  Would highly recommend.
Like the reviews say... The straps are long so I kept having to pull them up. The color is fantastic and I received loads of compliments!

I loved this dress and so did everyone else.  The color really popped and it was elegant.  I am small up top and hippier in the bottom, so that caused the dress to wrinkle in the middle.  Which caused me to stress all night...and not be 100% comfortable.  Maybe a better strapless bra would have helped.  I used spanxx for coverage also.

I rented this for a Gatsby themed bachelorette party and it was perfect for the occasion. It does fit tighter than it shows on the model, so I would order a size up if you aren't looking for it to be fitted, and even then it's pretty fitted. It does run kind of short, but I'm 5'11 and it was fine for me. It definitely has more sequins than it looks like in the picture, but I still liked it. Overall great dress and I think it looks really nice in photos :)
This dress runs a bit small, so I was happy I ordered a size up for my second size.  I am very tall (6'1") and the XL length was perfect for me.

What a dress! The material is thicker and has stretch to it, making it a super flattering fit. This style runs small. I would definitely recommend going up 1-2 sizes. When putting the dress on, be sure to loop the straps together before putting it over your head. The straps essentially form into a circle that you stick your head through. Again, definitely size up. I am usually a size 0 or 2, and the 4 was a perfect fit. Overall a fabulous LBD! Be sure to find rocking heels to pair along with it!
Dress runs very small in the waist, glad i got a back up size! Was slightly short for my height still even in a long, besides that was great.

I'm normally a 2, but read the reviews and knew to go a size up. I loved this dress so much! The fabric was very nice and a little thick, really well made. I'll probably be renting it in the sangria color for another event.

this ran smaller then typical for this designer.  I would have sized up and liked it better on me.  I did not end up wearing it for that reason.  need volleyball shorts in nude or white or other under it is not lined.  I would rent again in the size S

I loved this dress, it was so much fun to wear. Wore it to a wedding downtown Chicago. Got compliments all night. At first I was a little nervous it was too formal, but it was great. Very tight in the ribcage area, but felt perftect everywhere else. Slits were perfect height to show a little leg, but not too much. Over all, I wish I could keep it!

I read some reviews saying the top was shorter than expected, which I also found to be true.  Otherwise, the fit of the top was ok, but the arm holes were very small. Overall, I didn't like the fit or the silhouette of this top.
I wore this to a rehearsal dinner. It was very flattering and beautiful. Like others have said it rides up when you sit, or walk. I wish it would have been more easy to wear!!

I loved the dress but it did not allow for much movement. It was a bit hard to get on and off and the bottom part was quite form fitting. I am glad I ordered a medium even though I am usually a small with Yumi Kim.

I loved the shape of this dress; however, it runs VERY SMALL. I usually wear a size 2 and the 4 was very tight. I would recommend going up a size and ordering a size up from that as your backup. As someone with a small chest, the 4 was a tad loose in that area, but very form-fitting around hips. I literally had to unzip the dress to go to the bathroom. This is not one that you can pull up. Overall, I thought it looked great, but no doubt it was suck-it-in-all-night-tight.

This dress was either mismarked or it runs way too short. I almost 5'10" (got the 2 Long) and when I stood bare foot this dress didn't even touch the ground, making it look ridiculous in heels. I ended up going with another dress last minute cause there's no way I could wear this.
As others have said, this dress runs short.  Even without shoes on, this dress was short.  Make sure you order the tall size if you are over 5'6.
Runs small. I usually wear a 4 and I barely fit into the 6.
Fun, Flirty! Runs small. Goes great with a statement necklace or earrings. I wore it wine tasting for my birthday and it was perfect!

The fabric for this shirt is perfect for spring.  It really is a darling top, but it was sadly not the right proportion for me.  The fit was a perfect except for the chest.  As in the previous review, it is intended for smaller bosomed ladies.  I think that the shirt could accommodate at most a B-cup.

... Which honestly couldn't have been a more perfect situation. I'm tall and got the 4L and 6L -- the 4L fit perfectly, but was a little snug around my booty and I definitely didn't want to wear a bra, so I went with the 6L for the wedding. I did 2 inch block heels and the length was PERFECT, which was cool because I was really concerned about that previously. I got a ton of compliments, it was perfect for a formal wedding, and felt just the right amount of sultry without overdoing it.

Rented this for my birthday for something different. The 0R fit perfect everywhere, except that I couldn't zip it all the way, thanks to my large chest. . Because of this, I had to go up a size to the 2R, which was too large in the thighs/hips, but the top is so flattering I was able to work around it. Considering renting this in the future despite my sizing issues.

The material felt very nice and the polka dot pattern was really cute in person.  The front was too low cut for me not to wear a shirt underneath.  The only part of the dress that felt small was the arms, though it wasn't uncomfortable enough not to wear and it wasn't noticeable to other people.
Very nice leather - but runs small!   I am normally a small, but had to return it.

The skirt is so lose and flowing, but the top pulls it all in.  I normally wear a size 2, but could not zip this one up around my rib cage.  I am small bobbed, but the zipper would not let me even get that far.  Overnighted the next size up, and it worked perfectly.

My first choice for my event was too big, and at the last minute, RTR saved the day and sent me this as a replacement. Unfortunately, it bunched too much in the waist and was a bit too tight in the hips (for my personal comfort). Overall a bad fit, and the fabric looked and felt cheap on me.  have no doubt that this dress will look cute and festive on the right body, but mine certainly wasn't it. Thanks, RTR, for the great customer service!
I would rent one size up than your normal size.

Wore this for a black tie NYE wedding with chunky gem necklace. I got the 6 and 8 and wore the 8 since I have a little bigger than normal ribcage. I am 5'5", 138 lbs, and the length was perfect with 4" heels. The color was really fun and dress was in good shape. I would recommend it :)

This is a beautiful dress.. it runs really large! I am 5'8" 137 and the size 4 reg was so big I could not wear it. I probably needed a zero which is kind of silly vanity sizing. I am not ever  wearing anything smaller than a 4.

This dress was perfect for my bachelorette party! It was so sparkly - I  LOVED it! The dress definitely runs large. I wore the small and I typically wear a medium.  The sequins did scratch my arms up a bit, but it was not too uncomfortable. There is a lot of stretch in the dress.  I am very tall so it was super short on me. I ordered both a small and a medium and the medium did not seem to provide much extra length.

I'm 8 months pregnant with twins and the M fit perfectly, even on my 5'9" frame. So I would assume it's pretty long for a maxi. I belted it because it is a little shapeless on its own, but the colors are gorgeous, classic Lilly.

I wore this dress to my 30th birthday.  This dress was extremely itchy (the sequins kind of poke though from the outside).  Since it was december, I wore it with black tights and a black blazer and it looked great.  This tights helped a lot with the itchy-ness.  I does kid of pooch out in the middle because it has more of a blousy effect on the top and more fitted bottom.  It also has a bit of a low cut top.

I wore this dress to a holiday cocktail party in NYC.  Many of my husband's colleagues and associates were going to be in attendance, so I needed a dress that wasn't revealing, but pretty enough to turn heads.  This dress did the job beautifully.  It has absolutely no presence on the hanger, so I was nervous when I first pulled it out of the garment bag.  But when I put it on, wow!  It made my waist look tiny and accented what needed to be accented.  I had no issues with the zippers on the sleeves, and they did not poke into my arms like others had said.  The sleeves are narrow, but I had enough room to move around comfortably.  The dress itself is very comfortable, though there is no stretch to the fabric. I agree that it runs on the big side, and I probably could have worn a 4, but I always size up when renting, just in case.  Each brand sizes differently, and I'd rather the dress be too big than too small.  The 6 was fine.
 I'm 5'7", and the front hem hit maybe 3 inches above my knee, which is shorter than I usually go, but the longer back hem kept it from being inappropriate.  I wore it with the Kendra Scott Phoenix necklace and a pair of nude strappy heels.  This color is extremely flattering, and I think it would complement any complexion.  Highly recommend this dress!  Thanks for another happy experience, RTR!!

I rented this top for a weekend in Las Vegas and was so pleased! The feather details add just the right amount of flair, without being too over the top. I expected the top half of the top to be silk, but was pleasantly surprised to find it was a thicker material that remained wrinkle-free throughout the night and doesn't stick to your body. I am a 34B and usually wear a S in tops and ordered a size 2 after reading reviews. However, I definitely wish I had ordered a size 0. The straps are non-adjustable, so the 2 ended up being a little baggy under the arms and on the sides and sat low on my chest. Overall, still very happy with the top and definitely recommend for a fun night out! I paired with the Kate Spade "FUN" clutch and received so many compliments on both.

I usually wear a 2 or a 4.  I read the reviews on this dress and decided to rent the 2, but it was still way too big, especially on top, so I didn't end up wearing it.  This dress is lovely, and I'm sure would look great on someone with a larger chest.

Getting married in August, although I seriously loved my wedding dress, I knew I wanted a back-up plan in case I was getting hot and needed to liberate my legs from their sweaty silk/taffeta prison at the end of the night. Between that and picking up my gown all over the dance floor, I was ready for something lightweight and fun so I"m SO glad I got this dress! I had looked forever for something that felt befitting a wedding, and this blush sequin dress was the right mix of formal, glam, and fun (and not actually trying to be a wedding dress).  It was flattering, I didn't have to wear a bra or suck in (yes and yes).  It made it easy and fun to leave and enjoy the post-party without dragging my dress everywhere. I put a bridesmaid in charge of dropping it in the mail the next morning. It couldn't have been easier! I highly recommend this dress :)
However, it is a flattering, gorgeous and comfortable feeling dress so... I would have been happy to wear it if it fit me.

This dress was very comfortable and appropriate for my bridal shower. The fabric is softer than I anticipated (a lot of reviews described it as thick, I thought it was an average weight and flowed nicely). Ran a little big in my opinion as I usually take a 4 and wore the 2 in this.
I usually wear a size 2 and the dress was just a little big around the waist
The fit was a little big, especially in the chest. The fabric was very thick making the dress feel heavy. I did receive a lot of compliments on the dress!

I did not end up wearing this dress as I was looking for something younger. I would rent this again for a work event rather than a wedding or maybe if I was a little older.  It really was a nice dress and well made
A perfect outfit for an afternoon tea!!

I was so excited to get this dress, i've been eyeing it since it came out. it did not disappoint, except for the fact that it was a little roomy in the waist area and HUGE on my chest... no amount of fashion tape was going to help. so i went to Victoria's secret the next day and bought a strapless bra that adds 2 cup sizes, this seemed to help keep it up alot better. it also ran long even with my 4 1'2" heels it was still long. this sounds like a lott of complaining but really it was a beautiful dress and i was able to make it work. i've come too notice from past experience of renting, badgley mischka tends to run to big for my body type. so now i know for future renting.

Breezy material, perfect for spring or summer. This Opening Ceremony dress runs on the larger side, with an oversized fit. Love the print and asymmetrical look. Perfect for a casual, weekend look. There is plenty of room in the bust, waist, and hips and you can get away with wearing a standard bra underneath. At 5'7", the longest part of the hem hit just above my ankle. Wear with sandals or heels boots.

I was very happy with this dress, it was ridiculously comfortable.  I probably could've worn one size smaller for a sexier look.  I have long legs and it fell just right as short but not revealing length.
This dress was so big it fell completely off, so no chance with say a super padded bra. Disappointing b/c it really is a stunning piece. Wish RTR carried 00.

This dress was so much fun to wear. I wore it to fundraiser with a "festive cocktail" attire, and it exceeded my expectations. The material was very comfortable, the fit was very flattering, and it was snug enough that I didn't have to worry about anything moving while I was dancing the night away. On the fit, I would note that I am consistently always a 2 in dresses, and I very rarely have a dress that doesn't fit perfectly as a 2. I'm glad that I got the 0 as well as the 2, because the 2 in this one was definitely way too big up top. If you're small chested or narrow in the shoulder region, you'll want to go a size down. The straps on the 2 were too roomy and the neckline plunged way too deep. The 0 however fit like a glove. The straps were snug without being too tight, and the chest region was perfect for my mid-sized chest. The underarms can be a bit scratchy due to the sequins rubbing, but they didn't distract me from having a great time. Also, the zipper can be a huge pain, so you'll definitely need a friend to help get you in and out of it. Overall, I couldn't have been more happy. It was a perfect length, especially with heels, and got me compliments all night!
it ran a little loose but loved it with white pants

Believe all the comments... this runs large. I wore the XS and it fit perfectly. The neck is a little tight when you sit down, so I wouldn't recommend for a sit down dinner, but it was really flattering and felt like I was wearing pajamas all night. :)

This jumpsuit is very comfortable and easy to wear. The color is a lot brighter in person (pinkish coral), which makes it perfect for summer. It definitely runs quite large, I would not order this style if you are any smaller than me. The 2R was big, but I think the 0R or 0L would have been perfect. The hips are slightly fitted, but no need to size up. I would recommend pairing this with an edgy statement necklace!
A little large in the top area. I wear a 32b and it seemed loose on me. Other than that it was perfect for a North Carolina summer wedding

Material was heavy and wonderfully made (did not have to worry about wrinkles or the dress sticking to my hose). I felt like this is a dress that Taylor Swift would love. I paired the dress with black hose, black suede heels, and red lips. The silver detailing was perfect for NYE (as lots of the party props were silver, gold, and black). I wish I could have kept this one! It was super comfy!

I usually wear about a 2 so i ordered a 2 and a 4 to be safe but the 2 was large on top but the waist fit. It also was a little longer than i thought, but I just put a small stitch in the bottom and it was perfect!
